run_ml_inference_her: run the ml_inference script to perform HER voltage prediction using linear regression on computational and experimental data
run_volcano_plot_pca: run the ml_inference script to generate a volcano plot of PC1 vs predicted voltage using PCA on energy features
run_parity_plot_cv: run the ml_inference script with cv_results_csv to generate a parity plot comparing experimental vs predicted SHE voltage
get_computational_df_to_predict: get aggregate mean energies per bulk_id from a computational CSV or Parquet file for ML inference
refactor_get_computational_df_to_predict: refactor get_computational_df_to_predict to support additional energy descriptors or file formats beyond CSV and Parquet
